mapper.select: SELECT * FROM om_simulation_resource_tbl osrt WHERE page_no = #{page_no} AND resource_org_size > -1 AND resource_status != 3 ORDER BY resource_name

SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(osrt.resource_new_size_type1) AS size1, CASE WHEN SUM(osrt.resource_new_size_type2) = 0 THEN SUM(osrt.resource_new_size_type1) ELSE SUM(osrt.resource_new_size_type2) END AS size2, CASE WHEN SUM(osrt.resource_new_size_type2) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((SUM(osrt.resource_new_size_type1) - SUM(osrt.resource_new_size_type2)) / SUM(osrt.resource_new_size_type1)::NUMERIC * 100, 2) END AS percentage, osrt.resource_type, osrt.resource_status FROM om_simulation_resource_tbl osrt WHERE page_no = #{page_no} AND osrt.resource_type BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND osrt.resource_org_size > 0 AND osrt.resource_status = 1 GROUP BY osrt.resource_type, osrt.resource_status ORDER BY osrt.resource_type

SELECT SUM(org_time) AS org_time, SUM(new_time) AS new_time, (SUM(org_time)-SUM(new_time)) AS diff_time, ROUND(((SUM(org_time) - SUM(new_time)) / SUM(org_time)::decimal) * 100, 2) AS percentage FROM om_simulation_resource_tbl osrt WHERE page_no = #{page_no}
